name: security-ip-geofencing-rules
title: Security IP Geofencing Rules
description: A country-based edge geofencing rule controller allowing developers to allow or block inbound CIDR traffic.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Geofence Country Rule Toggle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
